questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes array bounds in C?

options.text: valid indexes are below the element count
use i < count as the common traversal guard
index equal to count is out of bounds
The language automatically repairs the issue

questions.explanation: valid indexes are below the element count. Verify with strict warnings, a minimal program, and observable output.
